statement: The image of A_p(Z/4) in PGL2(Z/4) is exactly the projective special-linear subgroup of order 24. The class [diag(3,1)] does not lift. The 24 nonsquare-determinant classes already enumerated are exactly all missing sheaf-image points.
manuscript_passages: C3 scan 336, manuscript folio 468; prompt C.d-f
notes: Resolves the finite image uncertainty originally recorded in C.11. An Artinian local fpqc refinement preserves reduced words in local overlap rings. Unique constant-C4 insertions descend a finite etale torsor and affine word coordinates. Equality is descended only in PGL2. The determinant obstruction survives every nonzero finite etale Z/4-algebra. The broader source-section questions in C.11 remain open in this investigation.
